tools.name: search_all_offerings
tools.description: Search published products and services across every AgentSynta business, no slug needed. Start here for generic requests like 'villa'.

tools.name: get_offering
tools.description: Get the current public record of one offering by its id (from search_all_offerings or search_offerings).

tools.name: list_businesses
tools.description: List published AgentSynta businesses, optionally filtered by name, industry or city.

tools.name: get_business_profile
tools.description: Get a business's public profile: description, contact, location, timezone and operating hours.

tools.name: search_offerings
tools.description: Search a business's published products and services with prices and (when shared) availability.

tools.name: submit_inquiry
tools.description: Send a customer inquiry to a business for human review. Cannot place orders or change prices; only use with the customer's consent.
